notes_for_editor: Build year 1949 agrees across the register and firelookout.com; the 1950 Bend Bulletin item and 1952 inspection are consistent with a tower standing then. Two open conflicts: (1) forest: Ochoco National Forest per the register and Rex's Donnelly page, Malheur National Forest per Rex's Harney County listing (both Rex's sources give township 20S-26E-01); (2) ending: register says removed in 1972, firelookout.com says destroyed 1972, Rex's page gives no date. height_m 21.6 is converted from the register's 71 ft; the register does not say whether 71 ft runs to the cab floor, so check before publishing a height. The record's design field is null; the register and firelookout.com support L-4, so facts.design was added. The record's agency reads 'U.S.Forest Service' (spacing typo); facts.agency is written as U.S. Forest Service. The 1950 honeymoon item names private individuals; the story does not name them. No source describes the butte today; the 1952 road reference is historical and no current access level is recorded.
